challenge.description: Three seasons, each a boss: the hot steals your water, the wet drowns your stores and breeds fever, the cool is the only mercy. Stockpile, drain, endure.
challenge.name: The Monsoon

covers: Indian subcontinent: monsoon forest, groves, paddies and river ghats

feral orchard: Someone planted food here once. The trees remember.
mango grove: Old grafted trees. The fruit falls ripe.
river ghat: Still water. The pond is a pantry.

name: South Asia

ruins: A vegetable market, its stalls collapsed in rows. Pre-Burn. The weighing scales are still bolted to one counter — someone measured out their life here in kilos.
A government school, its classrooms open to the sky. Chalk dust still ghosts one blackboard: a half-erased lesson. The Burn took the wires; the walls kept standing out of spite.
A bus depot, the bays empty, one timetable still legible behind cracked glass. The routes outlived the buses.

scavenge.name: Sack of rice
scavenge.text: A torn sack, half-spilled. The grain inside is dry and clean — someone's winter, abandoned.

scavenge.name: Bag of masoor dal
scavenge.text: Red lentils in a stitched jute bag. The stitching held; the weevils never found it.

scavenge.name: Tin of mustard oil
scavenge.text: A square tin, seal unbroken. Pungent, golden — cooking fat and lamp oil in one.

scavenge.name: Block of jaggery
scavenge.text: Dark unrefined sugar, wrapped in cloth. Ants found the corner; most of it is yours.

scavenge.name: Brick of tea
scavenge.text: Compressed black tea, stamped with a garden name. Morale in a brick.

scavenge.name: Pouch of turmeric
scavenge.text: Ground haldi in a sealed pouch. Stains everything; heals more.

scavenge.name: Tinned hilsa
scavenge.text: A tin of the queen of fish, in mustard oil. The label shows a river that still runs.

scavenge.name: Coil of coir rope
scavenge.text: Coconut-fiber rope, still strong. The old hands made everything from this.

scavenge.name: ORS packets
scavenge.text: Oral rehydration salts, foil-sealed. For dehydration and dysentery — mix with CLEAN water.

scavenge.name: Ciprofloxacin strips
scavenge.text: Foil strips, seal intact. For bacterial gut infections — the monsoon special. Read the label.
